messages:
maya: Heads up — product needs a per-customer watchlist + dashboard for noisy neighbor detection. We want to surface org-level spikes, recent rollouts affecting latency, and quota burn. Need infra/runtime metrics we can rely on.

jamal: agree. we should start by listing required signals. my quick list: token_rate_per_org, p95_latency_per_org, error_rate_per_org, avg_batch_size, kv_cache_hit_ratio.

elaine: +1. runtime can emit those but we need to decide on labels: do we expose org_id raw or hashed? privacy concerns.

sophie: product requirement: org-admins should see only their org. Support teams need cross-org view with redaction. No raw prompts or user content in any dashboard.

aamir: SRE note: be careful with cardinality. token_rate_per_org at 1s granularity will blow up. recommend 1m rollups and sampled 10s for hot orgs.

kaori: UX: rollout UX should show "before/after" baseline when a customer flips to Dedicated or gets new routing policy. Want a small inline timeline in the per-org pane.

jamal: for noisy neighbor index, proposing simple formula: NN_index = zscore(token_rate_per_min) + zscore(p95_latency) * 0.7. threshold = 3.0. we can tune. Thoughts?

elaine: that seems fine. runtime can compute NN_index at aggregation layer and emit metric noisy_neighbor_index{org_id=...}. again, recommend org_id hashed server-side and a separate mapping service for authorized lookups.

aamir: alerts: on-call should get system-wide noisy neighbor alerts, but customer watchlist alerts should go to account team only. add a suppression window if automated routing fallback already in progress.

maya: security: confirm RBAC model. Console team — can you enforce that org_admin role only sees hashed->org mapping for their own org?

jamal: console: yes. we'll enforce tenant-scoped queries at the API layer. Implementation detail: add a new endpoint /api/v1/tenant_metrics?org_id=<id> that only accepts org-scoped tokens. Internals will query aggregated metrics table by hashed_org.

sophie: product asks for three pre-built views: (1) watchlist overview (multi-org for support), (2) per-customer pane (org admins), (3) rollout impact comparison. Also a traffic heatmap for noisy slots.

kaori: small mock: "Per-customer health" card with tokens/min, p95 latency, noisy_index, quota_remaining. Click to expand timeline + recent rollouts.

elaine: runtime needs the list of metrics and retention. What retention for per-org aggregates do you want? 90 days? 1 year?

maya: minimum 90 days, 1 year for enterprise customers behind Dedicated/Private could be optional add-on.

aamir: storage/cost: suggest storing raw 1m aggregates for 90d, 5m aggregates for 1y. Hot orgs (top 200 by token burn) keep 10s samples for 7d.

jamal: tagging: please ensure all metrics include model_variant and route_policy labels. That allows filtering by routing policy (fallbacks, canary).

elaine: note: model_variant label increases cardinality but it's useful for rollout impact. We can collapse variants into coarse buckets (gpt-4-like, gpt-3.5-like, quantized) to reduce cardinality.

sophie: also need a link from per-customer pane to rollout history + PR/commit that caused the change. can we surface latest deploy metadata?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: service/runtime v2.18.3 -> canary(5%). <https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/ci/4823|CI#4823> :rocket:

kaori: nice, tying deployment metadata will make triage faster. Please ensure event timestamps align with metric timestamps.

jamal: API contract proposal in PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-api/pull/987|platform-api#987>. It adds /tenant_metrics and /tenant_rollouts endpoints. Will include param: granularity=(10s|1m|5m) but server caps per-org.

elaine: runtime PR to emit hashed_org label: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/456|runtime#456>. Will also emit noisy_neighbor_index.

aamir: ops playbook stub: when noisy_index>4 for 15m and p95_latency increased >2x, throttle policy -> notify account team -> consider routing to lower-cost lane. I'll draft runbook.

maya: legal/security reminder: dashboards must never render or store prompt text. Also add audit log for who viewed per-org dashboards.

kaori: timeline: product wants an MVP in 3 sprints: watchlist + per-customer pane + alerting. Can we scope?

jamal: scoped MVP: metrics emission + aggregated table + tenant_metrics API + per-customer pane showing last 24h. No historical 1y retention in MVP.

elaine: runtime can deliver metric emission in 2 sprints if we keep label set minimal. Need acceptance tests: synthetic noisy org to validate NN_index.

sophie: I'll open a PR for the UX mock and acceptance criteria.

maya: action items: jamal to finalize API contract PR, elaine to land runtime PR for hashed_org + noisy_index, aamir to write runbook, kaori/sophie to finalize UX mock and RBAC matrix. We'll sync next Wed. :+1:

observability-bot: new ticket created: OBS-3241 "Per-customer watchlist + noisy neighbor metrics" assigned to jamal, elaine, aamir.

jamal: noted. tagging infra and billing to review cost impact.

maya: thanks everyone. we'll track in the product doc and circle back after PRs land. :eyes:
